# servfail Provider

SERVFAIL provider manages DNS records on the [SERVFAIL](https://servfail.network/) authoritative nameserver network via its PowerDNS-compatible HTTP API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    servfail = {
      source = "likhner/servfail"
    }
  }
}

# api_token is read from SERVFAIL_API_TOKEN
provider "servfail" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) SERVFAIL API token (generated on the SERVFAIL settings page). May also be set via the `SERVFAIL_API_TOKEN` environment variable (recommended).
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the PowerDNS-compatible API, including the `/api/v1` suffix. Defaults to `https://beta.servfail.network/api/v1`. May also be set via the `SERVFAIL_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
